---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new capability for Unreel
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

### Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the user need or problem (e.g. "I find myself scrolling Facebook Reels without realizing it...").

### Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it should work.

### Platform Scope
- [ ] Android (Exact counting, accessibility detector, overlay/friction)
- [ ] iOS (Estimated counting, DeviceActivity, Screen Time / FamilyControls)
- [ ] Cross-platform (Shared business logic, analytics, rule engine)

### Architecture Considerations
- Does this require a new domain port or entity?
- Does it require an Architecture Decision Record (ADR in `docs/adr/`)?
- Does it adhere to strict privacy rules (no on-screen text logging)?

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or wireframes here.
